source.title: 25 Places I Ate the Best Tacos in Mexico City

hooks: Birria Estilo Jalisco in Roma Norte, serving since 1992 (#10)
Taqueria El Torito in Centro: suadero and tripa campechano, open since 1957 (#22)
Tizne's Kalbi-style brisket taco (#12); the title says 25 but the list numbers 26

list.title: Best tacos in Mexico City: Julien's 15 taquerias
list.desc: Places from Cultures Traveled's "25 Places I Ate the Best Tacos in Mexico City" (https://culturestraveled.com/best-tacos-in-mexico-city/). Collected by PinWith, not made by Julien Casanova / Cultures Traveled.

items.title: Tacos Los Caramelos
items.memo: Asada taco on a flour tortilla, on the Narvarte and Roma Sur edge.

items.title: La Taquiza al Carbon
items.memo: Al pastor carved from the trompo in Narvarte.

items.title: Tacos Tony
items.memo: Ask for the suadero en trozo (in chunks).
items.check: Tacos Tony has more than one spot nearby; original stand used

items.title: Tacos Beto
items.memo: Suadero and longaniza cooked on a comal de bola.

items.title: Tacos El Gato Volador
items.memo: Open 24 hours; try the chupa, a mix of fillings.

items.title: Birria Estilo Jalisco
items.memo: Birria tacos plus consome from a stand running since 1992.

items.title: Tacos La Soledad
items.memo: Campechano with a choice of quesillo or provolone.

items.title: El Turuleto
items.memo: Seafood tacos; the Galan is a creamy shrimp taco.

items.title: Porcino
items.memo: House-smoked pork tacos, just north of Juarez in San Rafael.

items.title: Barbacoa Dani
items.memo: Lamb barbacoa; order the espalda (back) cut.
items.check: Google lists it as Dani's Barbacoa, weekends only

items.title: Taqueria El Torito
items.memo: Suadero and tripa campechano, serving since 1957.

items.title: Tacos de Canasta Don Kaly
items.memo: Basket tacos; the mole verde one is the pick.

message.subject: I listed your Mexico City taco guide on one map
message.body:
Hi Julien, I'm Adrian from PinWith, a map-list app.

I liked how many of your picks are old-timers, like the birria stand in Roma Norte going since 1992 and El Torito's suadero and tripa campechano since 1957. I put 15 of the places into one map: https://pinwith.me/@pinwith_en/culturestraveled-cdmx-best-tacos

It's private for now: only this link opens it, and I'll delete it if you'd rather I didn't.

With PinWith, your readers can follow in your footsteps: revisit the places you went or plan their own trip from one map, in their own language. That helps your content reach further.

If you like it, I'll move it to your account, credited to you, so you can link it in the post. Lists like this can also earn curators extra income: https://pinwith.me/for-creators?lang=en
No reply needed if it's not useful.

Adrian
